scope: IGR epic wf-b00262b1 — all 8 stories + fast-follows

findings.issue: Raw JSON.parse on config.json without safeJsonParse — prototype-pollution risk (security-patterns.md §2)
correlateMiss uses read-modify-writeFileSync while recordGateEvent uses appendFileSync; concurrent hook processes can silently lose events between read and overwrite
findings.recommendation: Make correlateMiss append a correction-annotation event instead of rewriting, OR use a file lock around read-modify-write

findings.issue: getByPath allows __proto__ / constructor / prototype traversal — security-patterns.md §3 violation
Intent artifact content injected into adversary prompt verbatim between triple-backtick fences — a file containing ``` could break fence boundary
findings.recommendation: Escape triple-backticks in injected file content; cap per-artifact injection length

findings.issue: loadPendingCorrections uses raw JSON.parse without prototype-pollution guard
findings.recommendation: Extend safeJsonParse with allowArray option OR add explicit pollution check post-parse

findings.issue: CLAUDE.md was not regenerated after template update — self-maintenance.md §1 violation. IGR section absent from active instructions.
catch (_parseErr) violates naming-conventions.md — unused catch must use _err, not descriptive variants
PINS header declares schema-format but body has no <!-- PIN: schema-format --> section marker — document-structure.md violation
findings.recommendation: Add <!-- PIN: schema-format --> marker OR remove schema-format from PINS header

findings.issue: Rubric fed to Logic Adversary as AI context has no PIN structure — document-structure.md compliance gap
findings.recommendation: Add PINS header + per-principle PIN markers

findings.issue: Telemetry double-counting: runGate dispatch event + gate's own internal recordGateEvent both fire for standards-gate and completion-truth-gate. Dedup comment exists but NO dedup code exists.
findings.recommendation: Either remove internal recordTelemetry from individual gates and rely on dispatch events, OR implement actual deduplication

findings.issue: parseArgs() duplicated byte-for-byte across flow-intent-framing, flow-architect-pass, flow-logic-adversary, flow-intent-bootstrap, flow-migrate-igr
PIN-section regex parser AND parseListItems duplicated. Architect file explicitly comments 'Same regex pattern as flow-intent-framing's parser'
findings.recommendation: Extract parsePinSections + parseListItems into shared utility

findings.issue: Missing isAdversaryDisabled() short-circuit — inconsistent with other IGR modules. Disabling logicAdversary.enabled in config has no effect.
verificationProofGate + completionTruthGate can produce contradictory verdicts on Tier 1 evidence (pass vs block)
findings.recommendation: Update verificationProofGate to check highestTier>=0 OR remove from qualityGates when completionTruth enabled

findings.issue: parseListItems duplicated verbatim (overlap with ARCH-003)
recordTelemetry passes iterations: verdict.round (current round index) — semantic is total iterations, avgIterations metric will be wrong
Math.max(...observations.map(...)) can RangeError on unbounded tiers array (theoretical stack limit)
autoConfirm parameter declared + documented but never consumed
findings.recommendation: Remove from API/JSDoc or implement the prompt it describes

findings.issue: Rotation race: concurrent processes can both pass size threshold before one renames, losing events across boundary
findings.recommendation: Use .lock file around rotate OR atomic temp+rename

findings.issue: Duplicate of SEC-003 — template getByPath __proto__ traversal
bootstrapedAt (single p) typo — harmless now, will silently return undefined if future code expects correct spelling
Hardcoded model IDs ('claude-sonnet-4-6','claude-opus-4-6') bypass config-driven model selection

patterns.description: IGR work produced 3 instances of code duplication. ENFORCEMENT_GAP — decisions.md §Code Quality mandates single-source-of-truth.
Template renderer misses prototype-pollution guard. ENFORCEMENT_GAP — rule is in security-patterns.md §3, violated by the very feature designed to catch these failures.
Two new IGR files use raw JSON.parse without safeJsonParse. ENFORCEMENT_GAP — security-patterns.md §2.

enforcementGaps.suggestion: Standards gate should flag JSON.parse( in new files when safeJsonParse is importable in the module
Rewrite rule to include the exact 3-line guard pattern for getByPath-style resolvers
PostToolUse hook detecting .workflow/templates/ changes + reminding to run flow bridge sync
Standards gate should flag any catch variable starting with _ that is not exactly '_err'

enforcementGapsResolved.fix: Track B B1 — flow-standards-checker now flags raw JSON.parse when safeJsonParse is importable in the same module
Track B B4 — rule rewritten with copy-paste 3-line guard pattern; standards-checker enforcement listed as future work in the rule itself
Track B B3 — new core/template-change-detector.js wired into existing PostToolUse hook (three-layer compliant); flow-bridge.js clears the marker on successful sync
Track B B2 — flow-standards-checker now flags catch (_X) where X != err as MUST_FIX
